chars.FIANCEE: a young Moroccan woman, about 25, wearing a mustard-yellow hijab, a long olive-green trench coat over a cream blouse, small gold hoop earrings
chars.MAN: a young Moroccan man, about 28, short black hair, light beard, wearing a burgundy hooded sweatshirt with a white chest stripe and dark blue jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan city street at late afternoon, seen from beside the man walking: the FIANCEE walks next to him, head down, lips pressed, silent and worried, hands gripping her bag strap, head-to-waist framing, her face clearly visible, man partly in foreground from behind his shoulder

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: the MAN walking on a Moroccan city sidewalk, mid-sentence then stopping talking, mouth half open, glancing sideways at someone off-frame with a puzzled look, head-to-waist framing

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: on the sidewalk the FIANCEE has stopped and turned to face the MAN, very serious expression, one hand raised slightly as if saying 'wait, listen', the MAN facing her surprised, both head-to-waist, faces visible, old Moroccan buildings and a cafe behind

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: close shot of the MAN on the street, eyes wide, eyebrows raised, sweating a little, comic panicked expression as his imagination runs wild, blurred street behind

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: the FIANCEE looking down, nervous, fidgeting with her fingers, about to confess something, the MAN in front of her leaning in, frozen, waiting anxiously, warm dusk light on a quiet Moroccan street, both faces visible
